backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all domain types (Subject, Chapter, StudySession, Test, etc.), persistent state maps, and public API methods for a CA Final Study Tracker app, with authorization and blob storage mixins applied.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a migration module with old/new actor type shapes and a `run` function that transforms the old subjects map into the new format on canister upgrade.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the `useSeedData` hook fix (detecting unseeded subjects, triggering seeding, adding timeout/fallback) to its relevant source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the build/planning process.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA titled 'CA Final Study Tracker', mounting the app at `#root` and loading `src/main.tsx` as a module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all application routes (Dashboard, Sessions, Revisions, Tests, SubjectDetail, ArchivedChapters, RewardVault, QuestionPapers) and exports the root `App` component.
frontend/src/components/AddChapterDialog: Dialog component for adding a new chapter to a subject, submitting chapter name and total topics to the backend via `ExtendedActor.addChapter` with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AddRevisionDialo: Dialog wrapper that renders `RevisionForm` inside a controlled dialog, closing it automatically on successful form submission.
frontend/src/components/AddSubjectDialog: A dialog component that wraps SubjectForm in a modal for adding a new subject, closing on successful submission.
frontend/src/components/AddTestDialog.ts: A controlled dialog component that renders TestForm inside a modal for creating a new test entry.
frontend/src/components/AISuggester.tsx: Card component that aggregates subjects, revisions, completed tests, and backend suggestions to display AI-generated study recommendations, highlighting low scores, urgent deadlines, and low-progress subjects.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Displays a chapter's progress with an editable completed-topics input, a progress bar, and options to upload or view PDF notes.
frontend/src/components/EditSubjectDialo: A dialog that opens SubjectForm pre-populated with an existing subject's data for updating progress.
frontend/src/components/ExamCountdown.ts: Displays a live countdown of days remaining until a hardcoded CA Final exam date of May 1, 2028.
frontend/src/components/InnerCAVoice.tsx: Shows a randomly selected motivational quote with a refresh button, styled as an 'Inner CA Voice' card.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the app shell with a sticky header, navigation links, exam countdown, main content outlet, and footer.
frontend/src/components/PdfUploader.tsx: Handles PDF file selection and upload (up to 10MB) to the backend actor for a given chapter, with progress feedback.
frontend/src/components/PdfViewer.tsx: Opens a dialog to fetch, display in an iframe, and download a chapter's PDF notes using a blob URL.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperLis: Lists uploaded question papers as cards with view buttons, delegating PDF display to QuestionPaperViewer.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperUpl: A form component that allows users to upload a named PDF question paper (max 10MB), with validation for file type/size and upload state managed via the `useUploadQuestionPaper` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperVie: A dialog component that fetches and displays a question paper PDF in an iframe using a blob URL, with a download button and loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/RevisionForm.tsx: A form component for scheduling a revision topic by selecting a subject, entering a topic name, and picking a date, which submits the data to the backend actor via `addRevisionTopic`.
frontend/src/components/RevisionSchedule: Displays revision topics grouped into overdue, upcoming, and completed sections, with checkboxes to mark items complete via the backend actor's `markRevisionComplete` method.
frontend/src/components/RewardCard.tsx: A card component that renders a single reward's name, description, unlock condition, progress bar, bonus XP, and locked/unlocked status.
frontend/src/components/SessionSummaries: Displays a scrollable list of study session summaries fetched via `useSessionSummaries`, with a copy-to-clipboard button for each entry.
Displays a study streak card with a dynamic flame icon and motivational message that scales visually based on the user's current streak count fetched via useUserProgress.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionForm: A form component for logging study sessions (date, subject, hours, topics, summary) that submits data to the backend actor, awards XP, and invalidates user progress cache on success.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionHist: Renders a sorted list of past study sessions fetched via useStudySessions, showing subject badge, date, topics covered, and hours per session.
frontend/src/components/SubjectCard.tsx: Displays a subject's progress, completion status, and overdue state in a card with View, Edit, and Delete actions, navigating to the subject detail page on view.
frontend/src/components/SubjectForm.tsx: A form for adding or editing a subject, handling name, total topics, completed topics, and target date fields, and calling the appropriate backend actor method on submit.
frontend/src/components/SubjectProgressO: Shows a grid of all subjects with their progress bars, topic counts, and due dates fetched via useSubjects, with loading and empty states handled.
frontend/src/components/TestAnalyticsCha: Renders a tabbed analytics card with a Recharts line chart showing test scores over time and a bar chart showing average scores by subject, using completed test data from a custom hook.
frontend/src/components/TestCard.tsx: Displays a single test's details (name, subject, date, score) and allows the user to enter or view their scored marks, updating the backend and awarding XP on submission.
frontend/src/components/TestForm.tsx: A form component for adding a new test with fields for name, subject, date, total marks, and chapters, submitting the data to the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/TestHistory.tsx: Shows subject-wise test performance progress bars and a tabbed list of all, pending, and completed tests using multiple data hooks and the TestCard component.
frontend/src/components/TodayGoalCard.ts: A card for setting and tracking a daily study hour goal, supporting goal creation, editing, and incrementing progress by one hour via backend actor calls.
frontend/src/components/XPLevelCard.tsx: Displays the user's current XP, level name, and progress toward the next level using a styled progress bar and gradient icon, with level thresholds defined locally.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor instance using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useArchivedChapters.t: Fetches archived chapters from the backend actor using React Query, returning the data along with loading and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useChapters.ts: Fetches all chapters from the backend and optionally filters them by subject name, returning an empty array on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useCompletedTests.ts: Fetches completed tests from the backend actor via React Query, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvaluateRewards.ts: Provides a mutation hook that calls the backend's evaluateRewards method and invalidates the rewards query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfBlobs.ts: Fetches PDF blob data for a given chapter name from the backend actor, returning the binary data or null.
frontend/src/hooks/usePendingTests.ts: Fetches pending tests from the backend actor using React Query, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting that all queries have been moved to dedicated hook files.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuestionPaperPdf.t: Fetches a question paper PDF by name from the backend actor, returning binary data or null.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuestionPapers.ts: Fetches all question paper metadata from the backend actor via React Query, returning an empty array on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSchedule.t: Fetches the revision schedule (list of revision topics) from the backend actor, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSuggestion: Fetches revision suggestion strings from the backend actor via React Query, returning an empty array on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useRewards.ts: Fetches all rewards from the backend actor using React Query, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useSeedData.ts: Idempotently seeds CA Final subjects and chapters into the backend if none exist, with timeout handling, retry support, and query cache invalidation on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionSummaries.t: Fetches session summary entries from the backend actor via React Query, returning an empty array on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudySessions.ts: Fetches study sessions from the backend actor using React Query, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubjects.ts: Fetches all subjects from the backend actor via React Query, swallowing errors to return an empty array and prevent UI crashes.
Fetches suggested subject name strings from the backend actor via React Query, returning an empty array on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useTests.ts: Fetches all tests from the backend actor using React Query, exposing data, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayGoal.ts: React Query hook that fetches today's study goal from the backend actor, returning the goal data, loading state, error, and a refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQuestionPape: React Query mutation hook that uploads a question paper PDF to the backend actor and invalidates the 'questionPapers' query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProgress.ts: Provides a query hook to fetch user XP/level/streak progress from the backend, plus a utility hook to invalidate the cached progress data.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives, defines Spider-Man red/blue themed CSS custom properties for light and dark modes, and adds a subtle web-pattern overlay utility class.
frontend/src/lib/actorTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for all backend data models (Subject, Chapter, Test, etc.) and the ExtendedActor interface that declares every backend canister method used by the frontend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
Page component that displays chapters archived from deleted subjects in a card grid, showing progress bars and PDF badge indicators.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing XP, streak, today's goal, subject stats, exam countdown, AI suggestions, and a subject card grid with seeding logic for CA Final data.
frontend/src/pages/QuestionPapersPage.ts: Page that renders the question paper upload form and the list of previously uploaded papers with a header and separator.
Page that displays the revision schedule and an 'Add Revision' dialog button, wiring refetch callbacks between the schedule component and the dialog.
frontend/src/pages/RewardVaultPage.tsx: Displays a grid of study rewards that can be unlocked by hitting study milestones, with a button to trigger reward evaluation and toast notifications for newly unlocked rewards.
frontend/src/pages/StudySessionsPage.tsx: Renders the Study Sessions page combining subject progress overview, revision schedule, a session logging form, session history, and AI-generated session summaries.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailPage.tsx: Shows a detail view for a specific subject, listing its chapters as cards with progress tracking, and allows adding new chapters via a dialog (disabled for Paper 4).
frontend/src/pages/TestsPage.tsx: Renders the Tests & Results page with an analytics chart, test history list, and a dialog for adding new test results.
frontend/src/utils/caFinalData.ts: Defines static data for CA Final exam subjects and their chapters sourced from ICAI, used to pre-populate subject and chapter information in the app.
frontend/src/utils/caQuotes.ts: Exports an array of motivational quotes addressed from a future CA self, along with helper functions to retrieve a random quote or a random quote excluding the current one.
frontend/src/utils/topicEmojis.ts: Provides a utility function that deterministically maps a topic name to a consistent emoji from a predefined list using a simple character-code hash.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), fonts, border radii, shadows, and keyframe animations, while enabling dark mode and including typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the CA Final Study Tracker project, recording known issues (subjects initialization hanging), existing feature fixes, and a pending backend fix request to reliably pre-populate CA Final subjects and chapters on first use.
